name: Desktop workstation keeps core controls in one viewport
description: Verifies the primary desktop practice surface does not require page scrolling to reach the mode switcher, microphone, tuner, and pitch trace.
expected: The mode switcher, Start listening button, target setup, live note/cents feedback, and pitch trace are visible together without page scrolling.

name: Match ingests one source and prepares stems automatically
description: Verifies Match treats upload or tab capture as one ingestion action and runs stem preparation automatically.
steps: Upload an audio file or record tab audio
expected: Processing begins without a separate split-vocals action and the workspace appears after synchronized stems and section analysis are ready.

name: Sections support multi-select ranges and repeat practice
description: Verifies a user can practice one section, a continuous range, or non-adjacent sections without finding timestamps.
expected: Selected sections remain visibly active and playback uses only the selected sequence in song order for the requested repeats.

name: Artist stem remains synchronized and independently controllable
description: Verifies the separated tracks stay aligned while the lead singer can be reduced or muted.
expected: Only the lead-vocal level changes; the instrumental and optional backing vocals remain synchronized.

name: Recorded take is separate and reviewed after completion
description: Verifies the microphone is recorded as its own track and comparison feedback is produced only after the take ends.
expected: The app returns post-take pitch-center, timing, energy-contour, and pitch-movement comparisons without mixing the microphone into the source recording.
